Pick one — a contact belongs to a single category.
Mock Drill: choose your drill experience — SOS Emergency or HELP, five minutes each.
Start Drill: a 5-minute drill that lets you experience the situation, build confidence and act fearlessly.
Step 1 of 11, Add Trusted Contacts: add minimum 2 and maximum 3. They receive a verification code and become your trusted contacts once they accept.
Step 2 of 11, Add Contact: enter their phone number and name, then send the verification code.
Step 3 of 11, In Case of Emergency: press SOS, or trigger the power button 3 times quickly.
Step 4 of 11, 5-Second Countdown: after 5 seconds the alert is sent and background recording starts. You can cancel within those 5 seconds.
Step 5 of 11, Audio Recording Started: every minute is stored on the server as evidence. In the drill it records 30 seconds only and is not stored.
Step 6 of 11, High Alert Sent: contacts receive an attention-grabbing alert tone rather than a normal ring, which is easily missed.
Step 7 of 11, What Your Contacts Have Received: your live location, battery and network, the other trusted contacts and 112, and nearby police and hospital details.
Step 8 of 11, Your Live Location: contacts can tap to follow your location in real time.
Step 9 of 11, Battery Percentage and Network Status: contacts can see how long your phone may last and whether you are reachable.
Step 10 of 11, Other Contacts and 112: each trusted contact gets the other contacts’ numbers and 112 to call back.
Step 11 of 11, Nearby Services Received: the nearest police station, ambulance and hospital near your location, so contacts can act without panicking.
Drill Complete: you have finished the 5-minute mock drill. You are prepared — stay alert, stay safe.
Drill today, be ready for any day. Experience gives you confidence; confidence helps you act fearlessly. PUKAAR.
Drill Completed: Individual plan at 699 rupees, Family up to 3 at 1199 rupees, and the special referral offer.
Special Referral Offer: invite 2 friends who buy PUKAAR within 7 days and your plan upgrades to Family up to 3 at no extra cost.
HELP Mock Drill: a 5-minute drill that lets you experience the situation, build confidence and act fearlessly.
Step 1 of 12, Select Help Contacts: add 1 primary contact, which is required, and up to 2 secondary contacts.
Step 2 of 12, Set Primary and Secondary Contacts: the primary is alerted first; if they do not respond within 1 minute the alert goes to the secondary contacts.
Step 3 of 12, Add Pre-saved Numbers: numbers such as a neighbour, son or daughter that are shared with all your contacts when you ask for help.
Step 4 of 12, Don’t Call the Elderly: when you trigger HELP, let PUKAAR notify your trusted contacts instead.
Step 5 of 12, Trigger HELP: tap HELP, or trigger the power button 3 times quickly.
Step 6 of 12, 5-Second Countdown: after 5 seconds the alert is sent to your primary contact. You can cancel within those 5 seconds.
Step 7 of 12, Alert Sent to Primary Contact: a high alert with a grabbing tone. With no response in 1 minute it goes to your secondary contacts.
Step 8 of 12, Information Shared: your live location, battery and network, pre-saved numbers, 112 and the nearest police station, ambulance and hospital.
Step 9 of 12, Primary Contact No Response: after 1 minute the alert moves to your secondary contacts on its own.
Step 10 of 12, What Your Contacts Have Received: a high alert tone, because a normal ring is easily missed during an emergency.
Step 11 of 12, They Take Action: they call you, then your pre-saved numbers, reach your location, contact the nearest services and act.
Step 12 of 12, Drill Complete: you have finished the HELP mock drill. You are prepared — stay alert, stay safe.
Alerted the moment you press SOS.
Alerted when you ask for assistance.
Alerted if Elderly Help sees no activity.
Share your code. Both of you get a free month.
Step 1, Trigger SOS: tap the SOS button, or press the power button 4 to 5 times.
Step 2, SOS Triggered: the alert is now live.
Step 3: the alert goes to your 3 trusted contacts.
Step 4, Grabbing Alert: contacts get a loud, unmissable alert with View and Call.
Step 5: recording starts automatically and uploads to the cloud.
Step 6: the recording is saved to the cloud every minute, so nothing is lost if the phone is damaged or switched off.
Step 7: the message carries your name, number, battery level, live location and active status.
Step 8: the nearest police station, ambulance and hospital are one tap away, along with 112.
Step 9: all 3 contacts see each other’s details, so they can act together.
Step 10: at panic time everything is ready — call, live location, recording, battery, emergency numbers and contact details.
Step 11: help reaches faster and lives are safer. PUKAAR — when you need, we notify.
One press starts all of this at once. You do not have to do anything else.
All three trusted contacts receive the alert at the same moment.
Audio begins recording automatically, without opening anything.
Everything is saved to the cloud
The recording is uploaded every minute, so it survives losing the phone.
Live location, battery level and your number are shared with the alert.
Emergency services are one tap away
Nearest police, ambulance and hospital are listed, along with 112.
The home button does one of two things. Switch between them at the top of the home screen.
A life-threatening emergency. Alerts your contacts, starts recording and puts emergency services one tap away.
You need a hand, not an ambulance. Reaches family and trusted contacts without escalating to emergency services.
The short version. The full terms are available from the website.
Pukaar sends alerts to the contacts you choose. It is not an emergency service and does not replace calling 112.
Alerts depend on your phone having power and a network connection. Delivery cannot be guaranteed in every situation.
You are responsible for keeping your contacts and medical details accurate and up to date.
Plans renew until cancelled. Cancelling stops future charges and keeps access until the current period ends.
Pukaar holds sensitive things. Here is what happens to them.
Shared only while an alert is active, and only with your chosen contacts.
Encrypted before upload and readable only by you and the contacts you alerted.
Stored on your device and sent only when an emergency alert is triggered.
Used to deliver alerts. Never sold, and never used for anything else.
You can remove recordings and close your account at any time.
Elderly Help keeps watch in the background and reaches your contacts if something seems wrong.
Enable Elderly Help and choose how long a quiet period should last.
Ordinary phone use counts as activity. Nothing is recorded or shared.
After a quiet period the phone asks whether everything is alright.
If there is no reply, your emergency contacts are notified with your location.
A quiet phone can be the first sign of trouble. This is what happens when yours goes quiet.
Six, ten or twelve hours without activity, set in Elderly Help.
Unlocking the phone or opening any app starts the count again.
You are notified before anyone else is contacted.
No response means your emergency contacts receive an alert.
